summary: Verified P1 fix: server-side ABC orderability preflight in POST /purchase-orders/{id}/abc-submit. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_abc_orderability_preflight.py with 6 tests covering the happy path, all four blocking scenarios (credit hold, inactive Ship-To, branch no longer associated, Ship-To missing) and a 'no stuck pending' retry test. All 6 pass. Re-ran the existing ABC contract suites (appointment contract, PO setup warning, cancel guard) single-worker — 32/32 still green, no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: _abc_orderability_preflight is invoked in abc_submit BEFORE the durable AbcOrderSubmission is created, so a blocked submit leaves no 'pending' row — verified end-to-end by test_blocked_submit_leaves_no_stuck_pending_and_retry_works (same submission_key retried after fix -> confirmed).
Preflight uses isSellable is False (strict False check, not falsy) which correctly avoids blocking on missing/absent fields.

Branch-not-associated check first inspects Ship-To.branches; if the DETAIL omits branches it falls back to locations.get_branch — matches the real ABC behavior encoded in mock_server (2010466-2 case).
AbcError/AbcTransportError from get_ship_to short-circuits with a retryable message (does NOT silently pass) — good fail-closed behavior.
Minor: preflight message 'is on credit hold (not sellable)' is user-friendly; branch inactive uses raw ABC status string (e.g. 'inactive'/'closed') which is fine but could be normalized.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own throwaway ABC PO via POST /api/purchase-orders (notes=TEST_P1_PREFLIGHT). No fixtures beyond ABC mock OAuth connect + defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the P1 preflight suite single-worker: pytest tests/test_abc_orderability_preflight.py -o addopts=''. The mock get_ship_to prefixes drive the negative paths: CREDITHOLD* -> isSellable=false, 9999999 -> status=inactive + empty branches, NOBRANCH* -> branches without 18, MISSING* -> {}. The PO's abc_ship_to_number is set at create time by passing it in the POST /api/purchase-orders body (create_po preserves the explicit value; the default only kicks in when omitted). submission_key must be a client-generated uuid4 hex.
rca of the issue: n/a — implementation already correct; testing confirms P1 preflight blocks all four failure modes, returns status='validation_failed' with a clear error, does not place an ABC order, and does not create a durable pending AbcOrderSubmission so the same submission_key can retry cleanly once the account is fixed.
